[intrigued] Your iPhone can turn its screen warm by itself every night.

[confident] Here's the fix. Put Night Shift on a schedule.

[delighted] Every evening the screen goes warm on its own, and back in the morning.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
